profile.headline: Senior Software Developer at D&H Distributing

positions.title: Senior Software Developer Team Lead
positions.description:
With Aptos I've had the pleasure to be the team lead for three very differently focused teams comprised of developers with a wide range of experience, business analysts, and QA analysts. I've also had the enriching experience of traveling to Bengaluru India to on-board and train new colleagues overseas.

Led a scrum team focused on a react native mobile application utilizing cloud based microservices, helping our customers transform their retail store fronts into highly efficient order fulfillment centers. 

Played a pivotal role in collaboration with the product team, offering technical insight to assist scoping out new feature work. 

Designed and developed containerized .NET Core microservices deployed to AWS using Kubernetes and helm charts, greatly increasing maintainability and scalability of the application. 

Initiated and managed performance testing with JMeter to identify and resolve performance issues during development before taking applications to market.

Previously led a platform/infrastructure team with focus on items such as security, solution optimization, cloud migration, application containerization, and enablement.

Led a team to completely redesign our deployment model using a Jenkins pipeline with Groovy scripts. Additionally, we added jobs to easily build NuGet packages and push containers to AWS repositories.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Contributed to the re-architecture of a monolithic solution, transitioning it towards a domain-driven design approach.

Developed and designed an internal RESTful api allowing our customers to integrate to a multitude of payment providers through a single generic system.

Managed and expanded 3rd party integrations, encompassing shipping services, payment providers, tax services, and e-commerce marketplaces.

Implemented secure user login information storage by incorporating SHA-256 hashing along with salts, enhancing the system's security measures.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Collaborated as a key member of an agile Scrum team, contributing to the development and enhancement of e-commerce applications through proficient software development practices.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Contributed to the development of an e-commerce application by addressing and resolving bug-related issues.

Addressed lower-priority issues independently outside of the agile team, contributing to skill growth and ensuring the resolution of minor issues in the development process.

positions.title: Technical Manager / Junior Developer
positions.description:
-Built Windows Forms mail application for state of Florida Fishing and Hunting license fulfillment.
-Developed several console applications for real time call statistics.
-Designed and developed multi-layered .NET web applications; increasing efficiency. 
-Controlled source code using Git coupled with Bitbucket and JIRA.
-Analyzed and built performance reports with data collected from various web applications involving sales and call center operations.
-Managed daily operations of 50+ staff member call center.
-Organized desktop deployments for company affiliated contracts.

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
-Effectively managed logistics, support, and maintenance for 1,000+ pieces of POS hardware and printers throughout the state.
-Troubleshot hardware, application, network, and usability issues amongst licensing sales agents throughout Florida.
